description:
You are a VFX Matchmove Artist. A sequence of 40 frames representing a drone flyover is located in '/home/ga/footage/'. Your task is to track the camera motion and solve the 3D camera trajectory.

1. Import the image sequence into the Movie Clip Editor.
2. Set the scene frame range to match the footage (1-40).
3. Track at least 15 features throughout the shot.
4. Solve the Camera Motion.
5. Ensure the Solve Error is less than 1.0 pixel (refine tracks if necessary).
6. Apply the solution to the active scene camera (Setup Tracking Scene).
7. Save the Blender file to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/tracking_solved.blend'.
